flashcard_questions.q: The breakdown of rock in situ (in its original place) by physical, chemical or biological processes.
A type of mechanical weathering where water enters cracks in rock, freezes, expands and eventually shatters the rock.
The downhill movement of material (rock, soil or vegetation) under the influence of gravity.

flashcard_questions.a: The distance of open water over which the wind blows to create waves.
Low-energy waves with a strong swash and weak backwash that deposit material on the beach.
